findings: Middleware placement breaks pipeline convention — Move GlobalExceptionMiddleware registration before app.UseCors() to follow standard ASP.NET Core middleware ordering (exception handling → CORS → auth → endpoints).

Inconsistent error handling pattern in InvoiceService — UpdateAsync throws KeyNotFoundException while other services return null for missing entities. Either make InvoiceService return null like the others, or update all services to throw KeyNotFoundException consistently.

SessionService validation adds latency — Member existence check requires database lookup on every session create. Consider caching member IDs or deferring validation to database constraints if performance becomes a bottleneck (possible concern, not blocking).
